reply.say:
Links are created in `shorten` (`src/links.js:5`) and stored in memory by `store.save` (`src/store.js:5`) with no timestamp. To make them expire, I'd store `createdAt` and check it in `follow` and `stats`.

Two things the code doesn't settle:

1. **How long do links last?** Every link could get the same lifetime (`LINK_TTL`, default 30 days), or the caller could set an optional `expiresIn` in the body of `POST /links`. **I'd pick:** one fixed lifetime for every link, with no new input to validate.
2. **What does an expired code return?** It could be `410 Gone` or the same `404` as an unknown code. **I'd pick:** `410 {error: "link expired"}` for both `follow` and `stats`.
reply.title: Expire short links

reply.say: Ready. Links will get a fixed 7-day lifetime, and `follow` and `stats` will return `410` once a link is older than that. `test/links.test.js` will need a test for an expired link.
reply.title: Expire short links after 7 days
reply.brief:
store.save(code, url): also record createdAt = Date.now()
links.js: LINK_TTL = 7 days in ms; isExpired(link) = Date.now() - link.createdAt > LINK_TTL
follow(code): unknown → 404; isExpired → 410 {error: "link expired"}, no visit counted; else 302
stats(code): unknown → 404; isExpired → 410 {error: "link expired"}; else 200
test: link older than 7 days → follow and stats return 410
